documents.title: Finish schedule: why every coat is scuff-sanded
documents.content: Every coat of lacquer or conversion varnish is scuff-sanded with 320 grit before the next coat goes on. Sanding gives the next coat a mechanical key; a coat laid on an unsanded coat bonds only chemically and, in a working kitchen with steam and grease, lifts within 12 months. Flash time between coats in a Texas August is 4 hours. The July 2026 finish-room log: 312 doors through the room, 4 returned, all from one rush order that skipped the scuff pass.

documents.title: Brass hardware care
documents.content: Clean brass pulls with warm water and a soft cloth. Never use the cleaner under the sink; ammonia strips the patina and the lacquer on lacquered brass.
